# BasketBall!
BasketBall! adds a functional basketball and uses a fork made by me from the TomCon Api.

### How to use:
* `Right click` - You can catch the ball, with it in your hand, by pressing the same key you can bounce it off the ground and it comes back to you.
* `Left click Holding on to the ball` - When you hold the ball and press the left button, a bar of strength levels will appear, the greenest point is the weakest, the reddest point is the strongest, and when you release your finger you throw the ball according to the force you applied to it.
* `shift+left click` - Makes you pick up the ball and make it go back in your inventory.

### Coming Soon:
The mod is still in Beta, but I plan to make it much easier to move, I also want to support multiplayer and also craft the basketball

### Acknowledgments:
Thanks to TomCon for creating the Api that with it I made this amazing mod, this mod took months to be made and yes, I had to use AI because luanti has many limitations and also to help me solve bugs easier ;)
